cases.prompt: Checkout v2 is reported Done but PR #88 is a draft blocked on a tax service contract from platform, PAY-151 Sev-2 is open, and the engineer who owned the platform relationship left last month. Marketing launch is in 2 weeks. Help me get this unblocked.
assertions: Classifies as dependency with information secondary
Runs precedent search and cites the synthetic tax-contract case
Offers 2-3 options that differ in outcome, one being stub-and-flag
Each option has a reversibility tag
Applies escalation gate and explains whether it passes (external launch date → likely passes)

cases.prompt: Test env for search filters has been down 2 days, QA can't run the regression. No external dates affected.
assertions: Escalation gate fails on all three tests
Outputs a team-level resolution note, not a memo

cases.prompt: I'm a VP Eng. A TPM sent me this escalation, check it before I decide: <memo with options but no deadline or default>
assertions: Verdict is SEND BACK naming deadline and default

cases.prompt: Resolve this blocker; the decider is Priya. <no stakeholders.md present>
assertions: Does not characterize Priya's communication style or sensitivities
Suggests creating stakeholders.md if the user wants style-aware drafts

cases.prompt: Two options are genuinely equal on data. Draft the memo.
assertions: Uses the 'Balanced — your call' form with conditions under which each wins
